name: [UPD 8.3] Pleb's Plane Crash Sandbox [ALPHA]
desc:
The most realistic plane crash physics on Roblox - with new updates every day!

Spawn airliners and fighters, set them up, then fly them yourself or press Run and watch them go. Every plane breaks apart piece by piece: wings snap, engines tear off, and the wreckage skids, burns or sinks.

• Trigger failures: engine fires, flame-outs, bird strikes, engines falling off, wings snapping and more
• Load the plane up with passengers
• Change the map and the weather
• Real cockpit warnings: PULL UP, SINK RATE, STALL
• Watch replays of your crashes
• Add to the crash counter shared by every player

Military Intervention game pass: fighter jets with guns and bombs, anti-aircraft guns and missile launchers. Shoot planes down, or crew the defences yourself.

Found a bug or got an idea? Use the Feedback button in the game - every message gets read!

Play on computer, mobile or console.

llm.loop: spawn planes -> set failures, passengers, map and weather -> run and watch them crash apart -> repeat
unique: very realistic aviation failures; donation-only monetisation
llm.thumbnails: clean plane renders with logo, wreckage, smoke
